ghi_chu: Bang DONG cac gia tri KHONG duoc dich tren man cua lat. Doi chieu HAI CHIEU voi tap ung vien sinh tu man that; VA moi dong duoc so GIA TRI giua hai luot tieng — chuoi phai Y HET nhau.

dong.vi_sao: Ten nay ve ra o cum Viec lam duoc tren /agents/[agentId] (Slack) va o thanh dieu huong ung dung (OneHub) — mot cho nam duoi gioi han route can ban ghi, mot cho nam ngoai goc gom chu cua bo thuoc man. Dong van chiu chieu do: neu no VE RA tren mot man do duoc, hai luot phai Y HET nhau, lech la DO.
Ten san pham ve ra o thanh dieu huong ung dung, nam ngoai goc gom chu cua bo thuoc man (goc la phan tu cha cua main). Dong van chiu chieu do: ve ra tren man do duoc ma hai luot lech nhau la DO.

ngoai_lat.ghi_chu: Chuoi NGOAI LAT: dot HAI da dich xong sau file hoan, nen khoi nay RONG co chu y. Giu khoi lai chu KHONG xoa — vang mat han la duong sach-gia, va chan ngoai-lat-rong cua dot hai bat dung dieu do.
